recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist square composition featuring a deep red field framed by a thin white border. A single, small vintage-style ticket stub is centered in the lower half, casting a sharp black drop shadow. The top center features a two-tiered typographic lockup combining a heavy slab serif and a fluid script.
coreVisualRelationships: Small central subject against a vast negative space
Contrast between rigid slab serif and organic script lettering
Monochromatic red palette with white and black accents
Sharp drop shadow creating depth on a flat plane
coreInvariants: Small, angled object in the lower-middle third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small ticket stub is positioned in the lower-center, scaled to occupy less than 5% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-center typographic lockup acts as the primary anchor, while the ticket provides a secondary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold top text, moves down through the empty red space, and rests on the detailed ticket stub.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely high; the red field dominates the composition to emphasize the smallness of the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red with low-value shadows and high-value white text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, blocky slabs with minimal contrast
Secondary text uses a connected, slanted script with varying line weights
Tight letter spacing in the slab serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping script letters to create a handwritten flow
Slightly rounded corners on the slab serif terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, heavy geometric form and a fluid, organic gestural form.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and blunt terminals.
Captures the casual, slanted handwritten feel of the secondary text.
Alternative heavy slab with similar geometric proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A solid deep red square background. Add a thin white double-line border near the edges. In the lower-center, place a small, rectangular vintage paper ticket at a 30-degree angle. The ticket should have a hard black drop shadow cast to the bottom-right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white text at the top center. The top line should be a heavy slab serif in all caps. The second line should be a fluid script in title case, positioned to slightly overlap the bottom of the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the background a uniform deep red?
Is the ticket stub small and angled?
Does the slab serif text have a heavy, blocky appearance?
Is there a thin white border around the entire composition?

mustRedesign: Artist name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the ticket shadow is distinct and black.
Check that the script text is legible despite the overlap.
Verify the border is perfectly aligned with the square frame.
Confirm the red color is consistent across the field.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color field + thin border + small central icon with hard shadow + dual-style typographic header.
